system.description: This protocol is exactly like the Terrestrial Circle spell Summon Elemental (see Exalted, p. 254), but only the elementals common to Autochthonia--crystal, lightning, metal, oil, smoke and steam--may be summoned with it. For more information on Autochthonian elementals, see pages 64-74. By use of Abscissic binding (The Books of Sorcery, Vol. IV--The Roll of Glorious Divinity I, pp. 79�84), elementals may be bound up to one month.
